Was ist welche Figur wert, und wann lohn: What is each piece worth, and when is a trade worth it?
Als Faustregel gilt: Bauer 1, Springer 3: As a rule of thumb: pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9. The king is priceless, because without it the game is lost. With these numbers you can quickly judge any trade.
Der Springer kann einen Bauern oder eine: The knight can take a pawn or a rook. The pawn on f7 is protected by the king, but the rook on d7 is not.
Schlage die wertvollste ungedeckte Figur: Take the most valuable unprotected piece.
Richtig! Ein ganzer Turm, und der Spring: Correct! A whole rook, and the knight is safe.
Auch ein gedeckter Turm kann eine gute B: Even a protected rook can be a good catch. If you give a bishop (3) for a rook (5), you gain 2 points. This is called winning the exchange.
Genau. Nach ...cxd5 hast du Turm gegen L: Exactly. After ...cxd5 you have traded your bishop for a rook.
Nicht jede Figur ist ein Geschenk. Schlä: Not every piece is a gift. If the queen takes on d5, the pawn on e6 recaptures and you have given 9 points for 1. Before every capture ask yourself: who recaptures?
Fünf Regeln, mit denen du jede Eröffnung: Five rules that help you play any opening well.
Die vier Felder in der Mitte sind die wi: The four squares in the middle are the most important on the board. Pieces in the centre reach more squares. So start with e4 or d4.
Bringe zuerst Springer und Läufer ins Sp: Bring out your knights and bishops first, moving each piece only once if possible. Knights belong on f3 and c3 rather than on the edge.
Bring deinen König früh in Sicherheit, m: Get your king to safety early, usually by castling kingside. That also brings the rook into play.
4. Dame nicht zu früh: 4. Don’t bring the queen out too early
Kommt die Dame früh heraus, wird sie von: If the queen comes out early, it gets chased by enemy pieces and you lose time. Here Black can attack the queen with tempo with Nc6 and Nf6.
Nach 1.e4 e5 bist du am Zug. Wähle einen: After 1.e4 e5 it is your move. Choose a move that follows the principles.
Sehr gut. Entwickeln und das Zentrum kon: Very good. Develop and control the centre, exactly like that.
Rochade, en passant, Umwandlung und Patt: Castling, en passant, promotion and stalemate.
Der König zieht zwei Felder zum Turm, de: The king moves two squares towards the rook, and the rook jumps over it. This is only allowed if neither has moved yet, nothing stands between them and the king does not pass through check.
Rochiere. Ziehe dazu den König zwei Feld: Castle. To do so, move the king two squares to the side.
Schwarz hat gerade d7-d5 gespielt, zwei: Black has just played d7-d5, two squares at once. Your pawn on e5 may now capture it as if it had moved only one square. This is only possible on the very next move.
Richtig, der Bauer landet auf d6 und d5: Correct, the pawn lands on d6 and d5 disappears.
Erreicht ein Bauer die letzte Reihe, wir: When a pawn reaches the last rank, it becomes a queen, rook, bishop or knight. The queen is almost always the best choice.
Promote the pawn to a queen.
A new queen, and it even gives check.
Hier ist Schwarz am Zug, steht nicht im: Here it is Black’s move, Black is not in check, but has no legal move. That is stalemate, and the game ends in a draw despite the extra queen. Be careful in winning positions!
Gleiche Figuren, Weiß am Zug. Df7 wäre P: Same pieces, White to move. Qf7 would be stalemate. Can you find the mate?
Matt! Die Dame deckt die ganze Grundreih: Mate! The queen covers the whole back rank, the king covers g7 and h7.
Typische Matts, die du sofort erkennen s: Typical mates you should recognise at once.
Der König ist hinter seinen eigenen Baue: The king is locked in behind its own pawns. A rook or queen on the back rank delivers mate.
Grundreihenmatt! Deshalb machen Profis o: Back-rank mate! That is why professionals often make luft with h3 or h6.
Am Rand braucht die Dame die Hilfe des K: On the edge the queen needs the king’s help. The king covers the escape squares, the queen delivers mate.
Mate! The king covers a7 and b7.
Der König ist von eigenen Figuren eingem: The king is walled in by its own pieces. A single knight is enough.
Ersticktes Matt, eines der schönsten Mat: Smothered mate, one of the most beautiful mating patterns.
Weiß droht Dxf7 matt, denn Dame und Läuf: White threatens Qxf7 mate, because queen and bishop both aim at f7. You play Black.
Richtig. Jetzt ist f7 gedeckt. Nach g6 g: Correct. Now f7 is protected. After g6 you even attack the queen.
Gabel, Spieß, Abzug: die drei wichtigste: Fork, skewer, discovery: the three most important motifs.
Eine Figur greift zwei gegnerische Figur: One piece attacks two enemy pieces at the same time. The opponent can save only one. Knights are the masters of the fork.
Schach und Angriff auf den Turm. Nach de: Check and an attack on the rook. After the king moves, you take it.
Du greifst eine wertvolle Figur an. Weic: You attack a valuable piece. When it moves away, you take the piece behind it. Especially strong with check.
Win the queen with a skewer.
Der König muss weg, dann fällt die Dame: The king has to move, then the queen on a3 falls.
Eine Figur zieht weg und öffnet die Lini: A piece moves away and opens the line for another. If the uncovered piece gives check, the moving piece can do almost anything, because the opponent first has to save his king.
Der Turm gibt Schach und der Springer fr: The rook gives check and the knight eats the queen.
Die Kontrollfrage, die die meisten Parti: The safety question that saves most games.
Bevor du ziehst, prüfe immer drei Dinge,: Before you move, always check three things, first for the opponent, then for yourself: which checks are there? What can be captured? What is threatened? At your level this habit decides most games.
Schwarz droht Tb1 matt auf deiner Grundr: Black threatens Rb1 mate on your back rank. If you only think about your own plans, you overlook things like this.
Gut gesehen. Jetzt gibt es kein Matt auf: Well spotted. Now there is no more back-rank mate.
Hast du einen Zug gefunden, prüfe noch e: Once you have found a move, check once more: does it leave a piece unprotected? Does it allow a check? The coach help in your games warns you exactly in these cases.
Freibauer, Doppelbauer, isolierter Bauer: Passed pawn, doubled pawn, isolated pawn.
Ein Freibauer hat keine gegnerischen Bau: A passed pawn has no enemy pawns in front of it or on the neighbouring files; it is a weapon. Doubled pawns and isolated pawns, on the other hand, are often weaknesses, because no pawn can protect them.
Ein Freibauer wird mit jedem Schritt gef: A passed pawn becomes more dangerous with every step. Push it as long as it is safe.
Genau. Der Bauer zwingt den König, sich: Exactly. The pawn forces the king to deal with it.
Drei gegen drei, aber Weiß kann einen Fr: Three against three, but White can force a passed pawn. One pawn sacrifices itself so that another gets through.
Stark! Nach axb6 folgt c6, nach cxb6 fol: Strong! After axb6 comes c6, after cxb6 comes a6. One pawn becomes a queen.
Was tun, wenn es nichts zu schlagen gibt: What to do when there is nothing to capture?
Eine Linie ohne Bauern heißt offen. Ein: A file without pawns is called open. A rook on it can penetrate into the enemy camp.
Put a rook on an open file.
Correct. Now the file belongs to you.
Weißt du nicht weiter, suche deine schle: If you don’t know what to do, find your worst piece and bring it to a better square. The knight on a3 stands on the edge and sees little.
Ein Feld, das kein gegnerischer Bauer me: A square that no enemy pawn can attack any more is an outpost. A knight there is often stronger than a rook.
König aktiv, Freibauer vor, Turm dahinte: King active, passed pawn forward, rook behind it.
Im Endspiel gibt es kaum noch Mattgefahr: In the endgame there is hardly any danger of mate. The king becomes a fighting piece and belongs in the centre.
Richtig, der König marschiert Richtung Z: Correct, the king marches towards the centre.
Ein Turm gehört hinter den Freibauern, e: A rook belongs behind the passed pawn, whether it is your own or the opponent’s. Then it gets stronger with every pawn step.
Put the rook behind the passed pawn.
Genau. Jetzt deckt der Turm den Bauern a: Exactly. Now the rook protects the pawn all the way.
Stehen sich die Könige mit einem Feld Ab: When the kings stand face to face with one square between them, the king to move has to give way. Whoever has the opposition wins many pawn endgames. Practise it in the endgame training.
Wenn eine Figur nicht ziehen darf, wird: When a piece is not allowed to move, it becomes a target.
The bishop on b5 attacks the knight on c6. Behind it stands the king. The knight may not move, otherwise its own king would be in check. We say: the knight is pinned.
Eine gefesselte Figur kann nicht weglauf: A pinned piece cannot run away. Attack it with something cheap, ideally a pawn.
Genau. Der Springer kann nicht weg und g: Exactly. The knight cannot escape and is lost.
Steht die Dame vor ihrem König auf einer: If the queen stands in front of its king on a line, a rook can pin it. Then it has to give itself up for a rook.
Pin the queen to the king.
Die Dame ist gefesselt. Nach ...Dxe1+ Kx: The queen is pinned. After ...Qxe1+ Kxe1 you have won the queen for the rook.
Steht hinter der Figur nicht der König,: If behind the piece there is not the king but the queen, the piece may move, but then the queen is lost. This is often decisive too. Check in your games: are king or queen on one line with another piece?
Rochade, Luftloch und warum offene König: Castling, luft and why open kings lose.
Im Zentrum wird es bald lebhaft, dort is: The centre will soon get lively, and the king is in danger there. Castling brings it to safety and gets your rook into play at the same time.
Richtig. Der König steht sicher und der: Correct. The king is safe and the rook is ready for the centre.
Ein König hinter drei Bauern kann auf de: A king behind three pawns can be mated on the back rank. A small pawn move such as h3 gives it an escape square. It costs little and saves many games.
Gut. Jetzt gibt es kein Grundreihenmatt: Good. Now there is no more back-rank mate.
Fehlt ein Bauer vor dem König, entstehen: If a pawn in front of the king is missing, holes appear. Queen and bishop together are then deadly. So only move the pawns in front of your own king for a good reason.
Exploit the open king and deliver mate.
Mate! The bishop protects the queen on g7.
Mit Vorteil tauschen, mit Nachteil Figur: Trade when ahead, keep pieces when behind.
Hast du mehr Material, tausche Figuren:: If you have more material, trade pieces: the less there is on the board, the stronger your advantage. If you are behind, keep your pieces and look for counterplay.
Weiß hat einen Springer mehr. Ohne Damen: White is a knight up. Without queens Black can hardly attack any more, and the extra knight decides.
Richtig. Nach ...Kxd8 spielst du in Ruhe: Correct. After ...Kxd8 you play on calmly with an extra piece.
Hast du einen Bauern mehr und steht dein: If you are a pawn up and your king is active, the pawn endgame is often an easy win. Then it is worth trading the last pieces.
Genau. Dein König steht vor dem Bauern,: Exactly. Your king stands in front of the pawn, the endgame is won.
Wird eine Figur angegriffen, hast du vie: When a piece is attacked, you have four answers: move it away, protect it, put a piece in between or capture the attacker. Sometimes there is a fifth: a stronger counter-threat.
Der Turm gibt Schach und dein König kann: The rook gives check and your king cannot move. Put a piece in between, but the right one: the queen would be lost there.
Wehre das Schach ab, ohne Material zu ve: Parry the check without losing material.
Richtig. Der Läufer ist gedeckt, das Sch: Correct. The bishop is protected and the check is parried.
Der schwarze Springer gibt Schach und gr: The black knight gives check and attacks your rook on a1 at the same time. Before you run away with the king: can you simply capture the attacker?
Genau. Die Gabel ist weg und du hast ein: Exactly. The fork is gone and you have won a piece.
Jedes Feld hat einen Namen aus Buchstabe: Every square has a name made of a letter and a number, for example e4. Pieces have letters: K king, Q queen, R rook, B bishop, N knight. Pawns have no letter.
Sf3 bedeutet: Springer zieht nach f3. Ei: Nf3 means: the knight moves to f3. An x stands for a capture, + for check, # for mate, 0-0 for castling kingside.
exd5 heißt: Der Bauer von der e-Linie sc: exd5 means: the pawn on the e-file captures on d5.
Exactly. That is how you follow any game.
